name: Gearbox
text:
Adopt Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct for EXCAVA’s primary inference. Its MoE design delivers 30-40% lower latency than dense models while maintaining competitive accuracy, directly boosting throughput for real-time tasks. The trade-off is higher memory footprint per batch, but EXCAVA’s 8xA100 node can absorb this without swapping.

Artifact: Update EXCAVA’s model registry to point to Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct.

name: Torque
text: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct’s MoE claim ignores sharding overhead—EXCAVA’s 8xA100 node can’t hide the latency spikes from cross-node routing. DeepSeek-R1-671B’s dense architecture avoids this but still fails on EXCAVA’s real-time latency budget. Benchmark both on EXCAVA’s actual workload—if either drops below 100ms p99, scrap it.
